title: voice transcript (embedded)
description: A voice note's transcript, so a client can draw it under the note. The value under the `dev.agentpod.voice_transcript` content key of the hub's transcript notice (`m.notice`), which replies (`m.in_reply_to`) to the voice note: which note it belongs to is the reply relation, not a field here. The notice's `body` (`Transcript: ...`) stays the fallback. Mirrors AgentPod's `VoiceTranscript` and the hub's `transcriptContent` (`apps/hub/src/services/matrix-as/voice.ts`). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: The content's minor version. AgentPod sends 1. Additive changes raise it; a reader draws a higher version best-effort, never drops it.

text.description: What was heard, trimmed. The hub posts no transcript for a note with no speech.

language.description: The language the speech service heard, as an ISO code, when it said.

seconds.description: Length of the note in whole seconds, when the sender's client said.
